tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Code_iOS_Simulator__control
schema.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Simulator only: this tool cannot drive or stream a physical iPhone or iPad. If the user wants the app on their real device ("on my iPhone", "on my device"), build and deploy for the device with your normal build tools instead, and say the live panel only shows simulators. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). 'launch' installs and launches a built .app — build it first, with the user's own build tooling or this server's 'build' tool when this session has it; launch re-attaches on its own, but do not rely on that instead of the early attach. Screenshots and tap/swipe/text verification are headless and need no panel. Don't open the panel when the user only asked to build/compile or to run unit tests. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': path to the built .app bundle (e.g. DerivedData/.../Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

url.description: For 'open_url': URL or scheme to open in the simulator.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

import Ern.MM03
open Ern.MM03

/-- Pass-1 I1 (effective exclusivity, MM-03.3 §2 text), restated on the pass-2 model. -/
def I1eff (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ → Compat m₁ m₂

/-- Two unrelated Modify roots on leaf 0, each with an active Observe child. -/
def wS : S3 := ⟨[1, 0], 2, [⟨none, .frame 1, 0⟩], fun _ => .init,
  [⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 1, true⟩, ⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 1, true⟩,
   ⟨.observe, some 0, [0], .frame 1, true⟩, ⟨.observe, some 1, [0], .frame 1, true⟩],
  fun _ => [], fun _ => false, fun _ => false, fun _ => false⟩

-- effective modes on leaf 0 are all Observe
example : effective wS 0 0 = some .observe ∧ effective wS 1 0 = some .observe ∧
    effective wS 2 0 = some .observe ∧ effective wS 3 0 = some .observe := by decide

-- pass-1 I1 holds on wS
theorem wS_I1eff : I1eff wS := by
  intro a b p m₁ m₂ _ ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -, xp, ex⟩ := effective_some ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -, yp, ey⟩ := effective_some hb
  have hal := lt_of_getElem? hx; have hbl := lt_of_getElem? hy
  simp [wS] at hal hbl
  have hp : p = 0 := by
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 ∨ a = 2 ∨ a = 3 := by omega
    all_goals (simp [wS] at hx; subst hx; simpa using xp)
  subst hp
  have e : ∀ c, c < 4 → effective wS c 0 = some .observe := by decide
  rw [e a hal] at ha; rw [e b hbl] at hb; cases ha; cases hb; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

-- pass-2 (structural) I1 fails on wS
theorem wS_not_I1 : ¬ I1 wS := fun h => by
  have := h 0 1 ⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 1, true⟩ ⟨.modify, none, [0], .frame 1, true⟩ 0
    (by decide) rfl rfl rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  exact absurd this.1 (by decide)

/-- The pass-1 form of `effective_exclusive` (hypothesis: the spec's effective I1) still holds
on the pass-2 model, with a one-line proof. -/
theorem effective_exclusive_p1 {s : S3} (h : I1eff s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by decide)

#print axioms wS_I1eff
#print axioms wS_not_I1
#print axioms effective_exclusive_p1

/-- Pass-1 `addAuth_I1` (effective I1 preserved), ported verbatim onto the pass-2 model. -/
theorem addAuth_I1eff {s : S3} (h1 : I1eff s) {src : Nat} {x : Authority} {m : Mode} {fp : List Nat}
    {f : Holder} (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (hal : ∀ p ∈ fp, Allows (effective s src p) m) :
    I1eff (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) := by
  have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
  have hn : ∀ p e, effective (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) s.A.length p = some e →
      p ∈ fp ∧ e = m := by
    intro p e he
    obtain ⟨z, hz, -, zp, hze⟩ := effective_some he
    rw [addAuth_self] at hz; cases hz
    have : descModes (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) s.A.length p = [] := by
      apply nil_of_forall_not_mem; intro d hd
      obtain ⟨j, y, hy, -, -, hj, -⟩ := mem_descModes.1 hd
      have h1 := chain_lt hj
      have h2 := lt_of_getElem? hy; simp [S3.addAuth] at h2; omega
    rw [this] at hze; simp [effOf] at hze; exact ⟨zp, hze.symm⟩
  have hrel : ∀ b p e, b < s.A.length → p ∈ fp → (b = src ∨ b ∈ s.ancs src) →
      effective (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) b p = some e → e = .observe ∧ m = .observe := by
    intro b p e hb hp hbs he
    obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zp, hze⟩ := effective_some he
    have hm : m ∈ descModes (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) b p := by
      rw [descModes_addAuth, ancs_addAuth_self rfl hs]
      simp only [hp, true_and]
      rcases hbs with rfl | hbs <;> simp_all
    rcases effOf_cases hze with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hnm, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · exact ⟨rfl, mode_eq_observe fun e => hnm (e ▸ hm)⟩
  have hunrel : ∀ b p, b < s.A.length → ¬ (b = src ∨ b ∈ s.ancs src) →
      effective (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) b p = effective s b p := by
    intro b p hb hbs
    unfold effective; rw [addAuth_lt hb, descModes_addAuth, ancs_addAuth_self rfl hs]
    have : b ∉ src :: s.ancs src := fun h => hbs (List.mem_cons.1 h)
    simp [this]
  have newold : ∀ b p e e', b < s.A.length →
      effective (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) s.A.length p = some e →
      effective (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, f, true⟩) b p = some e' → Compat e e' := by
    intro b p e e' hb he he'
    obtain ⟨hp, rfl⟩ := hn p e he
    by_cases hbs : b = src ∨ b ∈ s.ancs src
    · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hrel b p e' hb hp hbs he'; exact ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
    · rw [hunrel b p hb hbs] at he'
      have hbs' : src ≠ b := fun h => hbs (.inl h.symm)
      have hal' := hal p hp
      unfold Allows OptP at hal'; split at hal'
      · rename_i e₀ he₀
        obtain ⟨c₁, c₂⟩ := h1 src b p e₀ e' hbs' he₀ he'
        exact ⟨Mode.le_observe (c₁ ▸ hal'), c₂⟩
      · exact hal'.elim
  intro a b p m₁ m₂ hab ha hb
  obtain ⟨_, ha', -⟩ := effective_some ha
  obtain ⟨_, hb', -⟩ := effective_some hb
  rcases addAuth_get ha' with ⟨hal₁, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩ <;> rcases addAuth_get hb' with ⟨hbl, -⟩ | ⟨rfl, -⟩
  · obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, o₁⟩ := effective_addAuth_old hal₁ ha
    obtain ⟨e₂, he₂, o₂⟩ := effective_addAuth_old hbl hb
    obtain ⟨c₁, c₂⟩ := h1 a b p e₁ e₂ hab he₁ he₂
    exact ⟨by rcases o₁ with rfl | rfl <;> first | rfl | assumption,
      by rcases o₂ with rfl | rfl <;> first | rfl | assumption⟩
  · exact (newold a p m₂ m₁ hal₁ hb ha).symm
  · exact newold b p m₁ m₂ hbl ha hb
  · exact absurd rfl hab

/-- Pass-1 `derive_preserves_exclusivity` (spec I1 on effective modes, MM-03.3 §10) still holds on
the pass-2 model. -/
theorem derive_preserves_exclusivity_p1 {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (h1 : I1eff s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : I1eff s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -, -, -, hal⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_I1eff h1 hx hal

#print axioms derive_preserves_exclusivity_p1

-- The pass-1 conclusions (on the spec's effective I1) of the two counterexamples still hold.
theorem split_breaks_I1eff : ¬ I1eff (splitEff c3a 0 [[1], [1]]) := fun h =>
  absurd (h 1 2 1 .modify .modify (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)).1 (by decide)
#print axioms split_breaks_I1eff

/-- `derive` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O1). -/
def DeriveStep (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src q m) (deriveEff s src q m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (MM-03.3 §3, O2): one derived `Modify` authority per
region, held by the current frame; the origin remains a logical authority. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p`: an active descendant of `src` in
mode `Modify` covering `p` (MM-03.3 §3, O2.4). -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2), in order: 1 the origin is an active, exercisable
(A2) authority with effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions; 2 regions within the available footprint
(the origin's footprint where its effective authority is present); 3 regions pairwise disjoint,
structurally (no shared leaf) or by `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8); 4 no region covers an
exclusive right already distributed. O2.5 is not restated: `split` changes neither `D` nor
activity. -/
def SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.Active src ∧ s.Exercisable src ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
  rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) := by
  unfold SplitPre; infer_instance

/-- `split` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (MM-03.3 §3, A6) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A6: end of a temporary access): the
authority becomes inactive. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with A := s.A.set a { x with active := false } }
  | none => s

/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor. O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions)
is not represented in the kernel. -/
    rcases effOf_cases he with ⟨h0, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨h0, h⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨hn, Mode.le_observe h⟩
  · exact h.elim

/-! ## Invariants (MM-03.3 §2, A1) -/

/-- I1, effective exclusivity strengthened structurally (MM-03.3 §2, A1): two distinct active
authorities, unrelated by `origin`, covering the same leaf, `SharedMutable` leaves included,
both have the proper mode `Observe`. The pass-1 statement on effective modes is the theorem
`effective_compat`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- I2, conservation of authorities (MM-03.3 §2): the origin of a derived authority exists, and
on each leaf of the derived footprint, the leaf is in the footprint of the origin and the
derived mode does not exceed the origin's. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint ∧ y.mode.le x.mode

/-- I3, validity of dependencies (MM-03.3 §2): every anchor of a usable place is valid, that is,
active (pass-1 arbitrage 2). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- I4, validity of consumed values (MM-03.3 §2), first sentence as a state predicate: no
`Moved` leaf is readable. The other sentences concern `transfer` and are theorems. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ a p, s.I p = .moved → ¬ CanReadLeaf s a p

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (MM-03.3 §2): the safety invariant. -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- I4 holds in every state: the read condition requires `Init` (MM-03.3 §2, I4; §5). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ hm h => by rw [h.2.1] at hm; cases hm

/-- `WF3` (A1): well-formedness, the domain of admissible states, separate from the safety
invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing places;
the stack is non-empty and without duplicates, below `nF`; owner frames are below `nF`; owner
places exist; a part comes after its parent and has its owner and its `dead` flag; every active
authority has a live holder (possession). -/
def WF3 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length) ∧
  s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ (∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
    o < s.P.length) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → HolderLive s y.holder)

/-- The pass-1 exclusivity on effective modes (MM-03.3 §2, I1) is a theorem under the
strengthened I1 (A1). -/
theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
      Compat m₁ m₂ := by
  intro a b p m₁ m₂ hab ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xp, ex⟩ := effective_some ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, yp, ey⟩ := effective_some hb
  have obs₁ : x.mode = .observe → m₁ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  have obs₂ : y.mode = .observe → m₂ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  by_cases hba : b ∈ s.ancs a
  · have hm : x.mode ∈ descModes s b p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨a, x, hx, xa, xp, hba, rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : x.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨obs₁ this, rfl⟩
  by_cases hab' : a ∈ s.ancs b
  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hab', rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : y.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨rfl, obs₂ this⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hab' hba
  exact ⟨obs₁ h₁, obs₂ h₂⟩

/-- `effective_exclusive` (MM-03.3 §10): under I1, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf
is the only one with a present effective mode there. -/
theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

/-- `shared_keeps_exclusivity` (A9): I1 holds on `SharedMutable` leaves like on any other leaf:
two unrelated active authorities covering such a leaf are both in `Observe`. -/
theorem shared_keeps_exclusivity {k : K} {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b : Nat} {x y : Authority}
    {p : Nat} (_hsh : k.SharedMutable p) (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
    (hy : s.A[b]? = some y) (xa : x.active = true) (ya : y.active = true)
    (xp : p ∈ x.footprint) (yp : p ∈ y.footprint) (hnab : a ∉ s.ancs b) (hnba : b ∉ s.ancs a) :
    x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe :=
  h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hnab hnba

/-- Central theorem (MM-03.3 §5): in a state satisfying `Inv3`, an authorised ordinary write
coexists with no other authority with a present effective mode on the written leaves. The proof
uses only the effective `Modify` of the writer. -/
theorem write3_exclusive {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (h : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')) : ∀ p ∈ ls, ∀ b, b ≠ a → effective s b p = none := by
  intro p hp b hb
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hw⟩, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact effective_exclusive hinv.1 (Ne.symm hb) (hw p hp).1

/-! ## Reused lemmas on chains, additions and skeletons -/

theorem nil_of_forall_not_mem {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a, a ∉ l) → l = []
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: _, h => absurd (List.mem_cons_self ..) (h a)

theorem pairwise_lt_range : ∀ n, (List.range n).Pairwise (· < ·)
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [List.range_succ, List.pairwise_append]
    exact ⟨pairwise_lt_range n, by simp, fun a ha b hb => by
      simp at hb; subst hb; exact List.mem_range.1 ha⟩

theorem filterMap_congr' {α β : Type} {f g : α → Option β} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, f a = g a) → l.filterMap f = l.filterMap g
    refine ⟨x, by rw [addAuth_lt hs]; exact hx, fun p hp => ⟨hfp p hp, ?_⟩⟩
    have := hal p hp; unfold Allows OptP at this; split at this
    · rename_i e he; exact Mode.le_trans this (effective_le hx he)
    · exact this.elim

/-- `derive` preserves `Inv3` without `WF3` (MM-03.3 §3, O1; A1). -/
theorem derive_preserves_inv3 {s s' : S3} {src q : Nat} {m : Mode} (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (h : DeriveStep src q m s (.ok s')) : Inv3 s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -, -, hfp, hal⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact addAuth_inv3 hinv hx (fun p hp => by simpa [S3.afp, hx] using hfp p hp) hal

theorem split_aux_inv3 {src : Nat} {x : Authority} : ∀ (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3), Inv3 s →
    s.A[src]? = some x →
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify ∧ p ∈ x.footprint) →
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') → Inv3 (splitEff s src rs)
  | [], s, hinv, _, _, _ => by
    have : splitEff s src [] = s := by simp [splitEff]
    rw [this]; exact hinv
  | r :: rs, s, hinv, hx, hr, hpw => by
    rw [splitEff_cons]
    have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
    have hinv₁ := addAuth_inv3 (m := .modify) (hd := .frame s.top) hinv hx
      (fun p hp => (hr r (List.mem_cons_self ..) p hp).2)
      (fun p hp => by rw [(hr r (List.mem_cons_self ..) p hp).1]; simp [Allows, OptP, Mode.le])
    obtain ⟨hpr, hpw⟩ := List.pairwise_cons.1 hpw
    refine split_aux_inv3 rs _ hinv₁ (by rw [addAuth_lt hs]; exact hx) (fun r' hr' p hp => ?_) hpw
    rw [effective_addAuth_notin hs fun h => hpr r' hr' p h hp]
    exact hr r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr') p hp

/-- `split` preserves `Inv3` without `WF3` (MM-03.3 §3, O2; A1), under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem split_preserves_inv3_underDD {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {s s' : S3} {src : Nat}
    {rs : List (List Nat)} (hinv : Inv3 s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : Inv3 s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, -⟩, -, h1, h2, h3, -⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine split_aux_inv3 rs s hinv hx (fun r hr p hp => ⟨h1 r hr p hp, ?_⟩)
    (h3.imp fun {r r'} h => h.elim id fun hd => hdd r r' hd)
  simpa [S3.afp, hx] using (h2 r hr p hp).1

/-- `split_preserves_exclusivity` (MM-03.3 §10): `split` preserves I1 under `Inv3` alone,
conditional on `DDSound k` (MM-03.3.8). -/
theorem split_preserves_exclusivity_underDD {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {s s' : S3} {src : Nat}
    {rs : List (List Nat)} (hinv : Inv3 s) (h : SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')) : I1 s' :=
  (split_preserves_inv3_underDD hdd hinv h).1

/-- `release` preserves `Inv3` without `WF3` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A1): the strengthened I1 only
constrains active authorities, which `release` removes. -/
theorem release_preserves_inv3 {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} (hinv : Inv3 s)
    (h : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')) : Inv3 s' := by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, hx, xa⟩, -, h3⟩, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  have ha := lt_of_getElem? hx

46:def chain (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chainF org i i
267:def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i
518:def descModes (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : List Mode :=
526:def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
531:def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
538:def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe
542:def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False
548:def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
    | some y => if y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ a ∈ s.ancs j then some y.mode else none
    | none => none

/-- Cases 1 to 3 of MM-03.3.5 for an active authority covering the leaf, of mode `m`, whose
active covering descendants have modes `ds`. -/
def effOf (m : Mode) (ds : List Mode) : Option Mode :=
  if ds = [] then some m else if Mode.modify ∈ ds then none else some .observe

/-- `effective(a, p)` (MM-03.3.5), computed per leaf, with no stored status: absent if `a` is
inactive or does not cover `p`, `effOf` otherwise. -/
def effective (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Option Mode :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => if x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint then effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) else none
  | none => none

/-- Compatibility of effective modes for ordinary accesses (MM-03.3 §2, I1): only
`Observe`/`Observe` is compatible. -/
def Compat (m₁ m₂ : Mode) : Prop := m₁ = .observe ∧ m₂ = .observe

/-- Effective mode `e` permits the requested mode `m`: present and not exceeded
(MM-03.3 §3, O1.3). -/
def Allows (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Prop := OptP e (fun e => m.le e) False

instance (e : Option Mode) (m : Mode) : Decidable (Allows e m) := by
  unfold Allows; infer_instance

/-- Footprint of authority `a`, empty if it does not exist. -/
def S3.afp (s : S3) (a : Nat) : List Nat := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => x.footprint
  | none => []

/-- Appends an authority to `A`: its identity is `s.A.length`. -/
def S3.addAuth (s : S3) (y : Authority) : S3 := { s with A := s.A ++ [y] }

/-- Anchors of the value at `q`, inherited from its parts (MM-03.3.6: a containing value
inherits the dependencies of the contained values). -/
def depsOf (s : S3) (q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r => decide (partOf s.P r q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Dependencies still valid for the values containing leaf `p` (MM-03.3 §5): every anchor of a
place of which `p` is a part is active. -/
def DepsValid (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, partOf s.P p q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (DepsValid s p) :=
